items.title: Drake Maye: Gets night off Thursday
items.body_text: Maye did not play in the Patriots' 13-13 preseason tie with the Colts on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: MarShawn Lloyd: Gets start in preseason opener
